title: Row.values list-view iterator
impact: Tried replacing `Row.values`' custom `_RowValueIterator` with a fixed-length `ListBase` slice view after a JIT `row_map_facade` sample suggested values iteration was slower than `LinkedHashMap.values`. The JIT signal did not reproduce cleanly, and the decisive AOT check reversed it: baseline `_RowValueIterator` values iteration stayed at 2.663 / 2.675 / 2.687 ms, while the list-view candidate regressed to 6.828 / 6.847 / 7.101 ms (~2.6x slower). Controls stayed neutral. No runtime code kept; future `Row.values` changes should compile the focused harness to AOT before trusting JIT microbenchmarks.
